entities.summary: Harvey Gallagher Cox Jr. is an American theologian and Baptist minister who served as the Hollis Professor of Divinity at Harvard Divinity School, until his retirement in October 2009. Cox's research and teaching focus on theological developments in world Christianity, including liberation theology and the role of Christianity in Latin America.
